scope: Read-only actual source audit; no compiled/native recognition proof

confirmed.admission: Every complete 320-sample frame must have RMS below 0.01 to refuse the full >=1600-sample window
confirmed.live: append keeps complete PCM; flush enqueues whole residual; transcribeWindow refuses before injected/native call
confirmed.final: MeetingFinalPass repeats the same containsSpeech refusal
confirmed.quietSuffix: Forwarded intact when any complete frame in the queued batch passes threshold
confirmed.pause: Low amplitude also treated as pause by nextCut/cutPoints; semantic/ASR fragmentation effect not proved
confirmed.recording: MeetingSession writes accepted packets before transcriber admission
confirmed.telemetry: silentSkipped counts windows but duration0; droppedAudioSeconds excludes these amplitude skips
confirmed.acceptance: Final60percent live word comparison cannot expose speech missing from both tiers

hypothesis: Separate pause hint from irreversible ASR admission; conservative digital-zero boundary remains proposed only, with native noise/hallucination/workload controls required
